L64: ## Press Releases

L66: Coinbase Global Set to Join S&P 500
L67: 
L68:   *   *   *   *   *   *   * NEW YORK, May 12, 2025 /【37†PRNewswire†www.prnewswire.com】/ -- Coinbase Global Inc. (NASD: COIN) will replace Discover Financial Services (NYSE: DFS) in the S&P 500 effective prior to the opening of trading on Monday, May 19. S&P 500 constituent Capital One Financial Corp. (NYSE: COF) is acquiring Discover Financial Services in a deal expected to be completed soon, pending final closing conditions.
L69: Following is a summary of the changes that will take place prior to the open of trading on the effective date:
L70: 
L71: Effective Date  | Index Name        | Action  | Company Name  | Ticker  | GICS Sector
L72: May 19, 2025  | S&P 500  | Addition  | Coinbase Global  | COIN  | Financials
L73: May 19, 2025  | S&P 500  | Deletion  | Discover Financial Services  | DFS  | Financials

L78: S&P Dow Jones Indices is the largest global resource for essential index-based concepts, data and research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500® and the Dow Jones Industrial Average®. More assets are invested in products based on our indices than products based on indices from any other provider in the world.
L79: Since Charles Dow invented the first index in 1884, S&P DJI has been innovating and developing indices across the spectrum of asset classes helping to define the way investors measure and trade the markets.
